audit_items.proof_trace: The function implements a read-modify-write pattern without atomic protection. ProposerLookahead() returns a clone under RLock, local modifications occur without lock, then SetProposerLookahead() writes under Lock. Concurrent calls can cause lost updates where the second write overwrites the first, violating the shift invariant.
audit_items.attack_scenario: An attacker influences network timing to trigger concurrent ProcessEpoch calls on different state copies or racing SetProposerLookahead calls. Thread A reads lookahead, computes shift [old_epoch1, new_epoch2], yields. Thread B writes [different_epoch1, different_epoch2]. Thread A resumes and overwrites with stale [old_epoch1, new_epoch2], causing incorrect proposer assignments and potential consensus failures.
